title: A new number wrote in our family chat as grandad 📱

scenes.narration: At 3:03 in the morning a new number wrote in our family chat as grandad.
Grandad died in March. We kept his number alive, so mum could still call it sometimes. The message said, who left the porch light on?
Nobody answered. Nobody else in the chat was even typing. Then a second message, only to me. You still sleep with the wardrobe open. I used to close it for you.
I never told anyone that. He did close it. Every night he stayed over. A quiet click, then his slippers going away down the hall.
I heard it then, in the dark. A soft click. The wardrobe door, closing by itself.
My phone buzzed. Do not turn around. Your mum is ringing this number right now, and I am trying to pick up.
The phone on my nightstand lit up. Mum, calling Grandad. And from inside the wardrobe, the old ringtone began to play. Then it stopped. Because someone had answered.
So tell me. Do you open the wardrobe, or run?
